window: historical database projections use a rolling 24 hours at the read-only transaction timestamp; workers, leases and outbox share that observation instant; mutation fences continue using the database wall clock
histogram_inclusion: all completed observed operations, including errors, cancelled and denied; process-local cumulative counters reset on process restart
latency_distributions: database p50/p95/max and sample counts are observable gauges recomputed from durable records, not mergeable histograms; empty distributions are omitted

admission_to_ready.point: first task.ready event minus task creation; includes dependency waiting

ready_to_claim.point: attempt.started_at minus task.ready event with exact generation; one sample per execution attempt

attempt.point: finished_at minus started_at; includes SUCCEEDED, FAILED, LOST and CANCELLED

task.point: terminal logical task updated_at minus created_at; includes retries, blocked and cancellation

workflow.point: first terminal event minus creation; physical DAG workflow, not approval wait

approval_wait.point: decided_at minus created_at; no sample while still pending

publication.point: terminal external operation updated_at minus created_at; includes failures/cancellation

model_reported.point: provider adapter reported latency_ms / 1000; fixture latency may be zero and is not live latency

state_gauges.workers: count: active=not draining and fresh configured heartbeat; available=at least one free slot
state_gauges.leases: count: active/expired RUNNING ownership; expired is a current gauge, expired_attempts is retained LOST history
state_gauges.outbox: count: PENDING rows only; excludes SENT/OBSOLETE
state_gauges.outbox_oldest_seconds: seconds: DB clock minus oldest PENDING availability, zero when empty
state_gauges.tasks: logical task counts by bounded status, created within 24h
state_gauges.attempts: execution attempt counts by bounded state, started within 24h
state_gauges.workflows: physical DAG workflow counts by bounded status, created within 24h
state_gauges.retries: persisted task.retry_wait events, separate from transport redelivery
state_gauges.broker_republications: sum of same-generation publish_revision; redelivery is separately observed from broker delivery metadata
state_gauges.repair_rounds: collab_projects.round; model correction, separate from infrastructure retry
state_gauges.approvals: approval counts by bounded status within 24h
state_gauges.publications: external intent counts by bounded status within 24h
state_gauges.reserved_cost_usd: USD: conservative session estimated charge; includes unknown retained reservations; not an invoice
state_gauges.unknown_usage_calls: count: unmatched model begin or unknown retained usage; never silently treated as zero

privacy: traceparent only; no baggage/tracestate, source, prompts, raw errors, credentials or repository URLs; IDs only in traces/logs
no_data: No samples is shown as no data. DB failure emits database_up=0 and omits state projections.
